description: Implementation of internal string formatting functions for the Abseil library, including integer and string conversions, formatting specifications, and related utilities.

classes.name: IntDigits
classes.description: Helper class for formatting integers into various bases and representations.

methods.name: ReducePadding
methods.description: Adjusts capacity based on string size or number of characters.

methods.name: PrintAsOct
methods.description: Prints an unsigned integer as octal.

methods.name: PrintAsHexLower
methods.description: Prints an unsigned integer as lowercase hexadecimal.

methods.name: PrintAsHexUpper
methods.description: Prints an unsigned integer as uppercase hexadecimal.

methods.name: with_neg_and_zero
methods.description: Returns the formatted value including sign if negative or zero.

methods.name: without_neg_or_zero
methods.description: Returns the formatted value excluding sign.

methods.name: is_negative
methods.description: Checks if the number is negative.
